description: This file defines a security plugin called GrafanaDetector that scans for Grafana secrets within source code using regex patterns. It extends a base detector class and specifies regex patterns to identify sensitive Grafana tokens such as API keys and service account tokens.

classes.name: GrafanaDetector
classes.description: A detector class that searches for Grafana secrets using regular expressions. It inherits from RegexBasedDetector and provides specific patterns to identify Grafana API keys and tokens.

methods.name: str secret_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the string 'Grafana Secret' indicating the type of secret this detector scans for.

methods.name: list[re.Pattern] denylist(self)
methods.description: Provides a list of compiled regex patterns designed to match different types of Grafana secrets such as API keys, cloud API tokens, and service account tokens.
